description_full: Betterware de México, S.A.P.I. de C.V. operates as a direct-to-consumer selling company in the United States and Mexico. It operates through Home Organization Products; and Beauty and Personal Care Products segments. The Home Organization Products segment provides a portfolio of products comprising kitchen and food preservation; home solutions; bedroom; bathroom; laundry and cleaning; wellness; and technology and mobility. The Beauty and Personal Care Products segment offers fragrances, color, skin care products, and toiletries. It sells its products through catalogues, as well as distributes through a network of distributors, associates, leaders, and consultants to the end customers. Betterware de México, S.A.P.I. de C.V. is headquartered in El Arenal, Mexico. The company operates as a subsidiary of Campalier S.A. de C.V.

financial_summary: Betterware de Mexico, S.A.P.I.  is a small-cap consumer cyclical business with a $677M market cap on $774M of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +16% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 21% against a 9% cost of capital — a 12-point spread that is the clearest signature of an economic moat. Gross margins of 68% confirm genuine pricing power.
On the balance sheet, debt is moderate at 2.5× net debt/EBITDA, serviceable in normal conditions but worth watching through a downturn, and thin 1.8× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.

Management returns a meaningful 8.1% of market cap to owners through dividends and buybacks, a strong signal of disciplined capital allocation, and insiders hold 65% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
